caseNameFull: Mrs. Camilla Davis Putnam, widow, etc. v. Mrs. Louise Stone Borst

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. Edwin T. Merrick for petitioners. Mr. D. B. H. Chaffe and Mr. E. J. Bowers for respondent.
